from tslearn.svm import TimeSeriesSVC
import numpy as np

# Initialize the classifier with probability=True as required
clf = TimeSeriesSVC(probability=True, kernel="gak", random_state=42)
clf.fit(X, y)

# Predict log probabilities
log_probs = clf.predict_log_proba(X)

# Verify the output shape and properties
n_classes = len(np.unique(y))
assert log_probs.shape == (X.shape[0], n_classes), f"Expected shape {(X.shape[0], n_classes)}, got {log_probs.shape}"

# Log probabilities should be <= 0 (allowing for minor floating point inaccuracies)
assert np.all(log_probs <= 1e-7), "Log probabilities should be less than or equal to 0"

# The sum of probabilities for each sample should be 1.0
probs_sum = np.exp(log_probs).sum(axis=1)
assert np.allclose(probs_sum, 1.0), "Exponentiated log probabilities must sum to 1.0 for each sample"

print(f"__CHECK__ predict_log_proba {log_probs.shape}")
